name: ICA Teens Programs (Teen Arts Council, Fast Forward, Photography Collective, Teen Exhibitions)
org: Institute of Contemporary Art, Boston (ICA Teens)
what_you_do: Join an after school arts group at the ICA. Groups include the Teen Arts Council, which plans teen events. Others are the Photography Collective, Fast Forward and Teen Exhibitions. The ICA says people in out of school time programs get paid.
who_can_apply: Teens of all skill levels and interests. The page does not give an age range, grades or a residency rule. Admission to the ICA is free for anyone 18 and under.
pay_detail: Participants receive compensation. The amount is not stated on the page.
duration: 2026 to 27 school year groups meet after school (4 to 7 p.m.; Teen Arts Council and Teen Exhibitions start at 4:30). Examples: Teen Arts Council Thursdays, Sept 10 to May 20; Fast Forward Wednesdays and Fridays, Oct 21 to May 5.
deadline_text: The page shows the 2026 to 27 schedules but no application dates or deadlines. Ask the ICA whether spots are still open.
how_to_apply: Email teens@icaboston.org to get involved. The Teen Arts Council and Teen Exhibitions pages mention an application, but the programs page does not explain how to submit it. Phone: 617-478-3100.
notes: Confirm first. Ages, pay amount and deadlines are not on the pages we could read. Boston Public School students from participating high schools can earn school credit for taking part. Other ICA teen programs had no dates set. They are the Teen Digital Cooperative, and the music and photo break intensives. Paid work for people under 18 in Massachusetts needs a work permit (employment permit). See permit.html?state=ma for the exact permit and steps.
